_comment: Movie-accurate default date/times. Edit freely - the web GUI reads this file fresh on every request, no restart needed. Fields: day, month, year, hour (1-12), minute, meridian (1=AM, 2=PM). These match the firmware's compiled-in gDefaultDestinationTime/gDefaultPresentTime/gDefaultLastDepartedTime arrays in App/Time_Circuits/timecircuit_control.c.
